name: finsignalhub-computer-use-plugin
description: Local-only FinSignalHub governance plugin draft for safe Computer Use recovery during GPT Pro stage reviews.
intended_workflow: Use Chrome extension or background browser control first for GPT Pro reviews.
Switch to Computer Use only when a callable Computer Use tool is exposed and the user is not actively using the foreground browser.
Inspect page state before input and stop on login, MFA, captcha, permission, privacy, payment, subscription renewal, or secret prompts.
Submit only the active stage review packet plus live GitHub gate evidence.
Save GPT Pro response, action items, final gate result, and next-stage instructions before a stage can pass.
restrictions: Does not install, expose, or emulate Computer Use.
Must not enter passwords, verification codes, payment data, API keys, tokens, or secrets.
Must stop on login, MFA, captcha, permission, privacy, payment, subscription renewal, or unclear consent prompts.
Must not use foreground keyboard or mouse automation while the user is actively using Chrome.
Must not commit screenshots or page captures containing private browser context.
Must not implement FinSignalHub runtime product behavior.
runtime_capability: governance-wrapper-only; does not install or expose Computer Use by itself
